verdict.rationale: Veriff's public API documents creating verification sessions (POST /v1/sessions) and polling outcomes (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision). Requests are authenticated with a shared-secret HMAC signature, and separate test integrations isolate development use. Retrieving extracted data and triggering re-checks are not clearly documented: decision triggering is limited to test integrations, and there is no MCP surface or published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented extracted-data retrieval endpoints, an API re-check/resubmission trigger for live sessions, fine-grained scoped credentials beyond per-integration keys, an MCP server, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the verification pipeline — create sessions, poll outcomes, retrieve extracted data, and trigger re-checks through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Use this endpoint to **initiate a new verification session** for an end-user. Every verification flow begins with creating a session.
